name: china-narrative-knowledge-platform
description: React + FastAPI 中国文学海外译介与中国叙事知识平台

scripts.build: npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.pages:build: npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npm.cmd run build --prefix frontend && python -m uvicorn backend.app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8002
scripts.check:backend: python -m py_compile backend/app/main.py backend/app/api/routes.py backend/app/core/data.py backend/app/core/security.py
